categories.main_business_segments: CMOC Group Limited operates primarily in the non-ferrous metal industry, focusing on mining, beneficiation, smelting, refining, and trading of base and rare metals. Key segments include copper, cobalt, molybdenum, tungsten, niobium, phosphate fertilizer production, and mineral trading. The company also has significant operations in phosphate fertilizer production in Brazil and is a leading base metal trader globally through its subsidiary IXM.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs large-scale, batch-based, continuous production methods integrating mining, processing, roasting, and chemical processing. It utilizes advanced modern mining technology, process improvements, and equipment, including 5G technology for unmanned intelligent mining. The company emphasizes technological innovation, digital management platforms (SAP Phase I), and eco-friendly mining designs to improve efficiency and sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CMOC serves a diverse customer base including downstream smelting plants, new energy supply chain producers, steel mills, fertilizer mixers in Brazil, and refined metal retailers. Its products cater to industries such as new energy vehicles, steel manufacturing, industrial upgrading, agriculture (fertilizers), and electronics. The trading business serves customers mainly in Asia and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with key mining and processing sites in China, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Brazil, Australia, and Indonesia. It has trading operations and offices in major global hubs including Hong Kong, London, Singapore, Sydney, Johannesburg, and Sao Paulo, serving markets across Asia, Africa, South America, Oceania, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: CMOC operates both upstream and midstream in the supply chain, engaging in resource acquisition, mining, beneficiation, smelting, refining, and mineral trading. Its trading subsidiary IXM operates downstream, integrating physical trading, arbitrage, and risk management to complement the mining business and extend the value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes a three-step development path emphasizing low cost and high efficiency, capacity ramp-up through world-class projects (TFM mixed ore and KFM), and achieving stellar growth. R&D priorities include technical innovation in mining and processing, digital transformation, ESG integration, and new energy metal resource acquisition, particularly lithium. The company also focuses on sustainable development and carbon neutrality by 2050.
categories.revenue_model: CMOC generates revenue primarily through the sale of mined and processed metals and minerals, including copper, cobalt, molybdenum, tungsten, niobium, phosphate fertilizers, and gold by-products. It also earns income from mineral trading activities via IXM, investment income, and gains from changes in fair value of financial instruments related to trading. The company employs both direct sales and trading distribution models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CMOC is positioned as a world-leading producer of tungsten, cobalt, niobium, molybdenum, and a major copper producer, ranking 20th among global mining companies by market value in 2022. It is the third largest base metal trader globally through IXM. Competitors include other large global mining and trading companies in base and rare metals, but CMOC differentiates itself with a unique product portfolio and integrated mining-trading business model.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, CMOC reported operating revenue of approximately RMB173 billion with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB6.07 billion, reflecting an 18.82% increase year-on-year. Total assets reached RMB165 billion, up 20.06%, and equity attributable to shareholders increased by 29.75%. The company has demonstrated strong growth, robust cash flow generation, and increased production capacity, supported by significant capital expenditures and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CMOC emphasizes its unique and diversified product portfolio covering base, special, and precious metals closely linked to energy transformation and industrial upgrading. It leverages low-cost, large-scale, and high-grade resource bases, advanced technology, and integrated mining and trading operations to create value. The company’s commitment to ESG leadership, sustainable development, and digital transformation further differentiates it as a modern, world-class resource company.
